title.en: An Act to Amend Article Six of Chapter Forty of the Revised Administrative Code, By Adding a New Section to Be Known as Section Fourteen Hundred and Ninety-Eight-A, Imposing a Tax on Saccharine.

text.en:
Article six of Chapter forty of the Revised Administrative Code is hereby amended by inserting
a new section, to be known as section fourteen hundred and ninety-eight-A, which shall read as follows:
"Section 1498-A. Tax on saccharine.-On saccharine there shall be collected a tax of sixty pesos per kilogram."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 13, 1931.
